DefaultSheet.Name: Evolved sheets: use as default
DefaultSheet.Hint: Use the Evolved hero and monster sheets as the default sheets for heroes and monsters (unticked: the Draw Steel sheets). Same as choosing them in Configure Default Sheets; actors with their own sheet choice keep it. Applies to everyone in the world.

AccentColor.Name: Evolved sheets: accent colour
AccentColor.Hint: Colour of the table headers, the active tab underline and the level badge on Evolved hero and monster sheets. Per client.

PortraitShape.Name: Evolved sheets: portrait shape
PortraitShape.Hint: How the portrait above the vitals strip is framed. Per client.

ClassArt.Name: Evolved sheets: class art in the header
ClassArt.Hint: Show the hero's class artwork behind the hero sheet header (the header then uses dark colours). Heroes without a class, or with a class that has no artwork, keep the plain header. Per client.

Portrait.Hint: The whole image shows while you hover. Drag it to choose what the frame shows, scroll to zoom, click to choose another image. Everyone sees this framing.
